GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2017-04-17T06:24:03Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Performance request/question: direct use of "arguments" variable inside a function 
Description: **TypeScript Version:**  2.2.2, Linux Ubuntu 16.04 x86_64.

I find it depressing that I cannot use the arguments variable somehow directly, that I have to see TypeScript creating a horrible duplication of memory, and waste of time. I think/wish/dream we should be able to use "...arguments" so that the generated javascript can just use "arguments" directly.

I think I want something like:

```ts
function foo(...arguments) {
   console.log( arguments[0] ); // TS2396
}
```

so I have to do something like:

```ts
function foo(...args) {
   console.log( args[0] ); // ok
}
```

but it generates depressing overhead in the final js:

```js
// the generated js 
    var args = [];
    for (var _i = 0; _i < arguments.length; _i++) {
        args[_i] = arguments[_i];
    }
```
